name: Pennington County, SD
findings: Pennington County has 451 nonprofit organizations. 200 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 159 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Pennington County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 11 political organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do political organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.text: 26 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
